scope: 13 distinct source paths across 14 visually reviewed pages. Outcomes adjudicate why a raw source phrase matches a printed page; they do NOT certify whole 1962 formularies, Bible editions, or global calendar use.

decisions.printedContext: 30 July: SS. Abdon and Sennen, Commemoratio
decisions.observedEvidence: Source file names SS. Fabian and Sebastian (20 January); OCR hit is a distinctly titled July 30 commemoration. Matching Gradual/Tract cannot license January calendar assignment.
decisions.remainingReview: Locate printed Jan 20 and establish 1962 commemoration status; compare chants separately.

decisions.printedContext: 30 June: In Commemoratione S. Pauli Apostoli, III classis
decisions.observedEvidence: Source for Conversion of St Paul (Jan 25) includes ex Sancti/06-30 in its Rank. The printed June 30 St Paul Mass confirms an actual Pauline text source at that location; reuse is purposeful, not an independent January page match.
decisions.remainingReview: Verify January 25 printed Proper, current 1962 rank and section substitutions before endorsing verse occurrence.

decisions.printedContext: Printed 462: St John Bosco formulary continues from January 31, followed by heading for 1 February St Ignatius
decisions.observedEvidence: Gradual Ps 36, Tract Ps 60, Offertory Ps 33 and Communion Rom 4 belong to the preceding John Bosco Mass despite February 1 running header.
decisions.remainingReview: Locate start of Jan 31 feast and match full Proper; confirm edition and biblical words.

decisions.printedContext: Printed 482: St Gabriel's Mass conclusion followed by March 4 St Casimir; printed 544: June 4 other feast
decisions.observedEvidence: St Gabriel source belongs to February 27; printed March 4 top page includes Gabriel Collect/Secreta/Communion and Gospel before St Casimir begins below. June 4 page carries a different Mass and overlapping strings.
decisions.remainingReview: Differentiate every fragment by its printed section and feast title before assigning Gabriel verses.

decisions.printedContext: 29 September: In Dedicatione S. Michaelis Archangeli, I classis
decisions.observedEvidence: Source names St Gabriel Archangel on March 24, whereas scanned page 670 is explicitly the September 29 St Michael dedication. Angelic text may be shared; no direct proof of March 24 Mass use.
decisions.remainingReview: Inspect 1962 calendar and printed text for March 24; distinguish omitted/commemorated vs transferred rubrics.

decisions.printedContext: 11 August: SS. Tiburtii and Susannae Virg., Martyrum; Commemoratio
decisions.observedEvidence: Source names SS. Marcellinus, Peter and Erasmus for June 2, contains inherited Common C3 directives; matched page is an August 11 martyrs' commemoration, not June 2.
decisions.remainingReview: Resolve Common C3 authentic printed source and June 2 status independently.

decisions.printedContext: 1 February: St Ignatius Bishop and Martyr, III classis
decisions.observedEvidence: Source labels St Joachim, Father of the BVM, on August 16; PDF page 463 names St Ignatius on February 1. Tract/Offertory string match cannot prove a St Joachim Mass.
decisions.remainingReview: Check 1962 placement of St Joachim and printed proper/Commons.

decisions.observedEvidence: Source suffix -pl corresponds to a Common of multiple non-bishop confessors in a supplemental section, not a dated July 13 celebration.
decisions.remainingReview: Resolve source type, edition appendix and corresponding celebration references.

decisions.printedContext: [200] Missae pro aliquibus locis: 9 September S. Petri Claver Confessoris
decisions.observedEvidence: Printed location is explicitly under Masses for certain places. Presence in scan does not authorize universal observance.
decisions.remainingReview: Confirm local proper applicability for geography/ordo separately; no universal-calendar import.

decisions.printedContext: Festa octobris (dominica ultima), printed 698; Gospel John 18:33-37
decisions.observedEvidence: Printed continuation includes Kingship texts, distinct seasonal chant options and 'Et non fit commemoratio dominicae'. Treat 10-DU as an ordinal Sunday rule, not a fixed calendar date.
decisions.remainingReview: Inspect preceding printed heading and 1962 rubrics for Christ the King before dynamic-date selection.

decisions.printedContext: Printed 693 under 21 October; previous St John formulary ends before St Hilarion commemoration begins
decisions.observedEvidence: The visible left column carries the preceding St John's Offertory/Communion and prayers; right column begins Oct 21 St Hilarion with Commemoratio.
decisions.remainingReview: Inspect beginning of October 20 Proper and isolate exact text transition.

decisions.printedContext: 15 September: Seven Sorrows of the Blessed Virgin Mary, II classis
decisions.observedEvidence: PDF page 656 is the September feast of Our Lady of Sorrows; overlap with a Passiontide source is not direct proof that this page witnesses the Friday of Passion week.
decisions.remainingReview: Check actual Passiontide Friday proper, Tract and Alleluia conditions at its original printed page.

decisions.observedEvidence: The page clearly belongs to Lenten Ember Saturday with additional prayers/lessons and the Transfiguration Gospel. A Pasc-prefixed source cannot inherit this liturgical date by coincident words.
decisions.remainingReview: Verify source alias/GradualeL boundary and correct Ember lesson order; do not infer a Paschal occurrence.
